Growing cultural uniformity across popular resorts arises when local operators prioritise commercial profits over authentic traditions. As a result, indigenous customs slowly fade, diminishing the unique charm that once attracted visitors.

Commercialising local attractions to suit mass-market preferences often triggers the loss of regional diversity. Therefore, historic communities risk becoming indistinguishable from one another, weakening their long-term tourism appeal.

skillFocus: Giải pháp & Giới hạn thực thi
promptVi: Giới hạn số lượng khách tham quan mỗi ngày là biện pháp thiết thực để bảo vệ các di tích lịch sử khỏi nguy cơ xuống cấp. Tuy nhiên, quy định này khó duy trì bền vững nếu cộng đồng địa phương phụ thuộc quá nhiều vào nguồn thu từ du lịch đại trà.
referenceAnswers: Capping daily visitor numbers is a practical measure to protect historic monuments from physical degradation. However, such restrictions remain difficult to sustain when local communities rely heavily on revenue from mass tourism.

Limiting tourist arrivals at heritage sites helps prevent overcrowding and structural wear. Even so, enforcing strict quotas proves challenging where regional livelihoods depend largely on high-volume travel.

Setting daily entry limits can safeguard ancient landmarks against excessive foot traffic. Nevertheless, authorities may struggle to uphold these rules without alternative income sources for tourism-dependent residents.

promptVi: Thế hệ trẻ ngày càng ít mặn mà với nghệ thuật truyền thống chủ yếu do các loại hình giải trí số hấp dẫn hơn và thiếu không gian biểu diễn gần gũi. Hệ quả là nhiều nghề thủ công lâu đời đứng trước nguy cơ mai một vì không có lớp kế cận.
referenceAnswers: Young people show declining interest in traditional arts mainly because digital entertainment is more engaging and performance venues remain scarce. Consequently, many time-honoured crafts face extinction due to a shortage of successors.

Youth disengagement from heritage art forms stems from the allure of online media and limited accessible stages. As a result, longstanding artisanal skills risk disappearing without younger practitioners to inherit them.

Modern digital platforms and the scarcity of community theatres draw young audiences away from indigenous performances. Therefore, centuries-old craftsmanship struggles to survive as fewer apprentices enter the trade.

rationaleVi: Cầu nối 2 câu liên kết chặt giúp chuyển tiếp mượt từ câu đơn lập luận Band 6.5 sang đoạn văn học thuật.

promptVi: Tỷ lệ béo phì ở thanh thiếu niên tăng vọt chủ yếu bắt nguồn từ thói quen tiêu thụ đồ uống nhiều đường và thực phẩm chế biến sẵn tiện lợi. Hậu quả là nguy cơ mắc bệnh tiểu đường sớm gia tăng, tạo áp lực lớn cho hệ thống y tế công cộng.
referenceAnswers: Rising adolescent obesity largely results from the widespread consumption of sugary beverages and convenient processed foods. Consequently, the risk of early-onset diabetes climbs steadily, placing a heavy burden on public healthcare systems.

Surging obesity rates among teenagers stem from frequent intake of sweetened drinks and ultra-processed meals. As a result, premature metabolic illnesses become more prevalent, straining national medical services.
Heavy reliance on high-sugar snacks and ready-made meals fuels weight gain among young people. Therefore, chronic conditions appear earlier in life, driving up national public healthcare expenditure.

skillFocus: Giải pháp & Giới hạn thực thi
promptVi: Đánh thuế cao đối với đồ ăn nhanh có thể thúc đẩy người tiêu dùng lựa chọn bữa ăn tươi sống và cân bằng dinh dưỡng hơn. Tuy nhiên, biện pháp tài chính này dễ tác động bất công tới các hộ thu nhập thấp nếu thực phẩm lành mạnh vẫn còn quá đắt đỏ.
referenceAnswers: Imposing higher taxes on fast food can nudge consumers towards fresher, more balanced diets. Even so, this fiscal policy may disproportionately penalise low-income households if nutritious ingredients remain overly expensive.

Raising levies on junk food may encourage shoppers to opt for healthier home-cooked meals. Nevertheless, such taxation unfairly burdens poorer families when wholesome produce stays financially out of reach.

Taxing unhealthy convenience meals can steer eating habits in a more nutritious direction. However, disadvantaged consumers still suffer financially unless governments also subsidise fresh fruit and vegetables.

commonErrors.correction: disproportionately penalise low-income households

skillFocus: Giải pháp & Giới hạn thực thi
promptVi: Bắt buộc ghi rõ hàm lượng calo trên thực đơn nhà hàng giúp thực khách kiểm soát khẩu phần ăn một cách chủ động hơn. Tuy vậy, thông tin dinh dưỡng này ít tạo ra thay đổi thực chất nếu thiếu kiến thức nền tảng về sức khỏe từ nhà trường.
referenceAnswers: Mandating calorie labels on restaurant menus enables diners to manage their portion sizes more consciously. However, such nutritional information rarely produces meaningful change without foundational health education in schools.

Requiring eateries to display energy counts empowers customers to regulate what they eat. Nevertheless, label transparency achieves little unless schools equip young people with basic dietary literacy.
Compulsory menu labelling allows patrons to make informed food choices when dining out. Even so, numerical figures alone cannot shift habits if consumers lack practical nutritional knowledge.

commonErrors.correction: such nutritional information rarely produces

promptVi: Áp lực thành tích quá lớn trong thể thao chuyên nghiệp bắt nguồn từ kỳ vọng khắt khe của người hâm mộ và giá trị hợp đồng tài trợ khổng lồ. Hệ quả là không ít vận động viên rơi vào kiệt sức tinh thần hoặc tìm đến chất cấm để duy trì phong độ.
referenceAnswers: Intense performance pressure in professional sport stems from demanding fan expectations and lucrative sponsorship contracts. Consequently, many athletes experience mental burnout or resort to banned substances to sustain peak form.

Excessive stress among elite competitors arises from relentless public scrutiny and high-value commercial endorsements. As a result, numerous sportspeople suffer psychological exhaustion or turn to illegal doping.

Massive financial incentives and unrealistic supporter demands place heavy strain on top athletes. Therefore, some competitors burn out emotionally or violate anti-doping rules simply to remain competitive.

rationaleVi: Cầu nối 2 câu liên kết chặt giúp chuyển tiếp mượt từ câu đơn lập luận Band 6.5 sang đoạn văn học thuật.

promptVi: Đầu tư xây dựng công viên và sân tập miễn phí tại khu dân cư giúp khuyến khích người dân duy trì thói quen vận động hằng ngày. Dù vậy, hạ tầng này có thể bị bỏ không nếu giờ làm việc kéo dài khiến người lao động không còn thời gian rảnh.
referenceAnswers: Investing in free neighbourhood parks and sports courts encourages residents to maintain daily exercise habits. Even so, these facilities may remain underused if long working hours leave employees with little leisure time.

Building accessible community gyms and green spaces motivates citizens to stay physically active. Nevertheless, public venues often sit empty when demanding work schedules deprive adults of spare time.

Providing complimentary local fitness infrastructure can foster regular physical activity across all age groups. However, overworked urban dwellers can scarcely benefit from such amenities without healthier work-life balance.

referenceAnswers: Children participate less in outdoor play partly because parents worry about safety and video games prove highly addictive. Consequently, young people often suffer declining physical fitness and weaker face-to-face social skills.

Declining outdoor recreation among youngsters stems from parental safety fears and the strong pull of digital gaming. As a result, children experience poorer stamina alongside diminished interpersonal abilities.

Safety concerns at home and immersive screen entertainment have curtailed kids' active playtime outdoors. Therefore, younger generations increasingly face noticeably reduced physical health and underdeveloped communication skills.

rationaleVi: Cầu nối 2 câu liên kết chặt giúp chuyển tiếp mượt từ câu đơn lập luận Band 6.5 sang đoạn văn học thuật.

referenceAnswers: The generation gap in modern families widens largely because hectic lifestyles leave parents and children little time for meaningful conversation. Consequently, mutual understanding erodes, often triggering persistent domestic conflicts.
Growing generational divides at home mainly stem from demanding schedules that limit genuine family dialogue. As a result, empathy between age groups weakens, fueling recurring household tensions.

Busy daily routines reduce opportunities for parents and children to share thoughts openly, widening intergenerational distance. Therefore, family members struggle to relate to one another, resulting in ongoing friction.

promptVi: Chính sách làm việc linh hoạt cho phép người lao động cân bằng tốt hơn giữa trách nhiệm gia đình và sự nghiệp cá nhân. Tuy vậy, giải pháp này khó được áp dụng rộng rãi trong những ngành đòi hỏi có mặt trực tiếp như sản xuất hoặc y tế.
referenceAnswers: Flexible working policies allow employees to balance family responsibilities with personal career goals more effectively. Even so, this arrangement remains difficult to adopt widely in frontline sectors such as manufacturing or healthcare.

Remote and adaptable work schedules help staff juggle household duties alongside professional ambitions. Nevertheless, such flexibility is rarely feasible for hands-on occupations that require physical presence on site.

Offering adaptable working hours supports parents in managing both domestic obligations and workplace demands. However, industrial and medical roles seldom accommodate remote arrangements due to operational constraints.

referenceAnswers: Encouraging elderly relatives to reside in modern care homes relieves daily caregiving pressure on busy adult children. However, this model gains broad acceptance provided that service fees remain affordable and social stigma gradually fades.

Placing ageing parents in well-equipped retirement facilities eases everyday care duties for working families. Nevertheless, wider adoption depends on reasonable pricing alongside a gradual shift away from cultural prejudice.
Professional nursing homes can lighten the caregiving burden borne by younger relatives. Even so, families will embrace this option only if fees are manageable and traditional disapproval diminishes.
